definition: Bytes in complete functions with separately audited inputs, outputs, side effects and control-flow behavior, divided by all executable memory bytes in the imported Dreams executable.
scope: Entire imported main executable, including unmapped executable memory and any executable import/loader regions. Does not cover other modules or game assets.
limits: Conservative minimum while existing analysis is re-audited; uncounted does not mean no understanding.
Byte coverage is a measurable proxy, not a proof of whole-game completion or equal effort per byte.
Static understanding and runtime validation are separate.
Function naming and extraction do not automatically count.

counted_functions.behavior: Complete static input/output and side-effect contract for the 97-byte function, under explicit valid-memory preconditions.
Complete static lookup behavior; prior full-body review, layout, caller and probe audit reconciled.

Complete normal-return initialization memory/register contract: six global reads, 41 stores, 408 distinct output bytes and 40 preserved bytes, under explicit nonalias, valid-memory and AVX preconditions. Mutable global data remains symbolic.
